name: Report Count
query:
SELECT 
    sa.full_name AS "Full Name:Data:200", 
    sa.employee AS "Employee ID:Link/Employee:150", 
    sa.branch AS "Branch:Link/Branch:150",
    COUNT(al.name) AS "Total Leads:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN al.company = 'Bit Stop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Bit Stop:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN al.company = 'Bitcoin Depot' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Bitcoin Depot:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN al.company = 'Un Bank' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Un Bank:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN al.company = 'Rockit Coin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Rockit Coin:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN al.company = 'Crypto Base' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Crypto Base:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN al.company = 'Coin Works' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Coin Works:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN al.company = 'Budget Coinz' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Budget Coinz:Int:100"
FROM 
    `tabATM Leads` al
JOIN 
    `tabSales Agent` sa ON al.executive_name = sa.employee
GROUP BY 
    sa.full_name, sa.employee, sa.branch
ORDER BY 
    sa.full_name;
